people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.”
translations.bsb: Here is a call for the perseverance of the saints, who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
